JK Accounting Group

About Us

A founder-led, bicultural accounting team for international owners building in the US — bookkeeping, tax, and CFO guidance in English, Ukrainian, and Russian.

JK Accounting Group

At JK Accounting Group, we understand that every financial decision you make impacts your future, and we're here to help you navigate those decisions with clarity and confidence. Our mission is to provide personalized, reliable, and expert accounting services that empower our clients to focus on what they do best.

Founded by Julia Kononova, a seasoned accountant with over a decade of experience, our firm is rooted in a passion for helping individuals and businesses achieve financial success. Her firm has helped hundreds of businesses simplify their bookkeeping, optimize tax planning, and gain deeper insights into their finances, creating a solid foundation for growth. Through careful attention to detail and a client-first approach, we strive to make financial management seamless and stress-free for everyone we serve.

Providing Value

Julia Kononova

Founder & Chief Accountant
English · Українська · Русский

Julia is a dedicated professional who has worked tirelessly to help thousands of business owners navigate financial challenges and streamline their operations. With a hands-on approach, Julia has built lasting relationships with her clients, guiding them through complex financial landscapes and helping them find clarity and confidence in their decisions.

Julia is highly educated and credentialed, holding an MBA in Finance and actively participating in several professional tax groups. As a Main Street Certified Tax Advisor, she brings legitimate expertise to every client interaction, ensuring her clients receive reliable and actionable financial guidance tailored to their needs.

Julia specializes in helping business owners minimize tax liabilities through strategic planning and proactive financial management. With a deep understanding of tax laws and financial strategies, she has guided clients in structuring their businesses to maximize savings and ensure compliance. Her expertise also extends to leveraging retirement accounts and real estate investments, offering clients the tools and knowledge they need to grow their wealth while securing their financial futures.

Building A Team

Julia knows that a successful accounting firm is built on more than just expertise—it's about the people who make it happen. That's why she has assembled a dedicated team of professionals who share her commitment to providing exceptional service. Each team member brings their own unique skills and experience, creating a well-rounded group that supports all of JK Accounting Group's clients with care and precision.

Julia Kononova

Founder & Chief Accountant
English · Українська · Русский

Julia Kononova is the driving force behind JK Accounting Group, with over a decade of experience in accounting and financial management. As the Chief Accountant, Julia combines precision with strategic insight, ensuring her clients receive expert guidance tailored to their unique needs. Passionate about empowering businesses, she leads the team with professionalism and a client-first approach.

Irina Jandieri

Tax Accountant
English · Русский · Українська

Deep tax and multi-entity experience, with a steady hand for complex returns.

Maria Zavarce

Senior Accountant
English · Español

Maria Zavarce is a dedicated Senior Accountant at JK Accounting Group, specializing in accurate financial reporting and client support. With a detail-oriented approach and a commitment to excellence, Maria ensures that each client's accounting needs are met efficiently. Her passion for numbers and personalized service makes her a vital part of the team.

Liudmyla Kazannik

Bookkeeper
English · Русский · Українська

Liudmyla Kazannik is a skilled bookkeeper at JK Accounting Group, specializing in maintaining accurate financial records and ensuring seamless account management. With a meticulous eye for detail and a passion for organization, she helps clients stay on top of their finances, making their day-to-day operations smoother and more efficient. Liudmyla's dedication to precision and her proactive approach to problem-solving make her an invaluable member of the team.

Lilian Gonzalez

Client Success & Bookkeeper
English · Español · Русский

Lilian Gonzalez is the friendly and efficient team member who helps keep JK Accounting Group running smoothly. From managing schedules and client communication to supporting the team behind the scenes, Lilian brings warmth, organization, and professionalism to every task. Her commitment to excellent service helps ensure that every client feels welcomed and well cared for.

Clients Success

At JK Accounting Group, our clients' success is our greatest achievement. Over the years, we've had the privilege of working with incredible businesses and individuals, helping them overcome challenges, seize opportunities, and achieve their financial goals. Here's what some of our clients have to say about their experience with us:

Why Outsource Your Accounting?

Smart, Efficient, and Expert Accounting Solutions

Save Time and Reduce Overhead

With JK Accounting, you eliminate the need to hire, train, and manage a full-time accountant, freeing up valuable time and resources for your business. By outsourcing your accounting needs to us, you can focus on what you do best—running and growing your business—while we handle the financial details with precision and care.

Affordable Access to Expertise

Gain the expertise of a seasoned accounting team for a fraction of the cost of maintaining in-house staff. With JK Accounting, you receive top-quality financial management, benefiting from our extensive experience across industries, without the expense of full-time salaries, benefits, and training.

Customized Solutions for Your Needs

Our services are tailored to fit your business, backed by experience working with clients across various industries. We bring proven solutions and fresh ideas from multiple sectors to address your unique challenges. As your financial needs grow and change, we adapt our strategies to keep your business on track.

Access to Tax Planning Expertise

Unlike traditional accountants, we provide proactive tax strategies that go beyond basic compliance. With JK Accounting, we carefully identify opportunities to minimize liabilities and maximize your savings, ensuring your business retains more revenue while staying fully compliant with ever-changing tax regulations.

Comprehensive Tax Filing Services

Rely on us to manage your tax returns with precision, ensuring they're prepared accurately and in full compliance with current regulations. With JK Accounting, you can rest assured your filings will be submitted on time, helping you avoid penalties and keeping your financial records in excellent standing.

Holistic Financial Management

With JK Accounting, you gain more than just bookkeeping. Our comprehensive services include detailed tax planning, precise filing, and expert financial advisory, all thoughtfully tailored to meet your business needs. We provide everything you need in one convenient place, ensuring your financial success and peace of mind.

Our Services

Bookkeeping

Stay organized and in control with our precise bookkeeping services. We handle your financial records with accuracy, ensuring up-to-date data that helps you make informed business decisions while saving you time and stress.

Tax Planning

Plan ahead and save more with our proactive tax planning solutions. We help you navigate complex regulations, minimize liabilities, and maximize savings, ensuring your business remains compliant and profitable year-round.

Tax Preparation

Streamline your tax season with our reliable and efficient tax preparation services. We ensure timely filings, minimize errors, and keep you stress-free with accurate documentation tailored to your specific needs.

Fractional CFO

Gain access to expert financial leadership with our Fractional CFO services. From cash flow management to strategic planning, we provide the insights and strategies needed to drive your business toward long-term success.

Focus on what you do best.

We'll handle the financial details with precision and care.

Book a Free Discovery Call

10 minutes · no obligation
